To evaluate this expression, we use PEMDAS. First, we perform the operation inside the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}({{1-4}_{⏟}}_{-3})^{2}\times \frac{1}{12} & =(-3)^{2}\times \frac{1}{12}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we compute the exponents:

$$
\begin{aligned}{{(-3)^{2}}_{⏟}}_{9}\times \frac{1}{12} & =9\times \frac{1}{12}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we multiply:

$$
\begin{aligned}9\times \frac{1}{12} & = \\ \frac{9}{1}\times \frac{1}{12} & = \\ \frac{9\times 1}{1\times 12} & = \\ \frac{9}{12} & = \\ \frac{9÷3}{12÷3} & = \\ \frac{3}{4}\end{aligned}
$$
